CÍM:
Easy pancakes

HOZZÁVALÓK:
100g plain flour
2 large eggs
300ml milk
1 tbsp sunflower or vegetable oil
extra oil for frying
lemon wedges optional
caster sugar optional

ELKÉSZÍTÉS:
1. Whisk flour, eggs, milk, oil and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter.
2. Rest the batter for about 30 minutes if time allows.
3. Heat and lightly oil a frying pan.
4. Cook thin pancakes one at a time, turning to brown both sides.
5. Serve with lemon and sugar if desired.
23:
CÍM:
Fish pie - in four steps

HOZZÁVALÓK:
400g skinless white fish fillet
400g skinless smoked haddock fillet
600ml semi-skimmed milk
1 small onion
4 cloves
2 bay leaves
4 eggs
small bunch parsley
100g butter
50g plain flour
pinch nutmeg
1kg floury potatoes
50g cheddar

ELKÉSZÍTÉS:
1. Poach the white fish and smoked haddock in milk with onion, cloves and bay leaves.
2. Boil the eggs and potatoes separately; mash the potatoes.
3. Use butter, flour and the poaching milk to make a white sauce, then season and add parsley.
4. Flake the fish into a baking dish, add the eggs and pour over the sauce.
5. Top with mashed potato and grated cheddar, then bake until golden.
28:
CÍM:
Chicken chilli con carne

HOZZÁVALÓK:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion
2 mixed peppers
2 large garlic cloves
1 small bunch coriander
0.5 tbsp ground coriander
1 tbsp ground cumin
1-2 tsp chipotle paste
400g can chopped tomatoes
1 tbsp tomato purée
300ml chicken stock
1 small cinnamon stick
4 skinless chicken thighs
400g can black beans
400g can kidney beans
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
20g dark chocolate

ELKÉSZÍTÉS:
1. Fry the onion and peppers until soft, then add garlic, coriander stalks, spices and chipotle.
2. Add tomatoes, tomato purée, stock and cinnamon.
3. Add the chicken thighs and simmer covered until tender.
4. Remove and shred the chicken, then return it to the pan.
5. Add both beans, vinegar and dark chocolate and simmer until thickened.
6. Remove the cinnamon stick, season and finish with coriander leaves.
25:
CÍM:
Easy apple crumble recipe

HOZZÁVALÓK:
575g Bramley apples
2 tbsp golden caster sugar
175g plain flour
110g golden caster sugar
110g cold butter
1 tbsp rolled oats optional
1 tbsp demerara sugar optional
cream or custard to serve

ELKÉSZÍTÉS:
1. Heat the oven.
2. Toss the sliced apples with sugar and place in a baking dish.
3. Mix flour and sugar, then rub in the cold butter until crumbly.
4. Spread the crumble over the apples.
5. Add oats and demerara sugar if using.
6. Bake until the topping is golden and the apples are soft, then rest briefly before serving.
30:
CÍM:
Guacamole

HOZZÁVALÓK:
0.5 small yellow onion or 0.25 red onion
2 cloves garlic
2 tsp kosher salt
3 ripe Hass avocados
2-4 tbsp fresh coriander
1 ripe plum tomato
0.5-1 jalapeno

ELKÉSZÍTÉS:
1. Soak the minced onion in cold water, then drain.
2. Mash garlic and salt into a paste and combine with the onion.
3. Halve and pit the avocados, scoop the flesh into the bowl and roughly mash.
4. Add coriander, tomato and jalapeño.
5. Mix gently so the guacamole stays chunky, then season and serve immediately.
29:
CÍM:
Classic Meatloaf

HOZZÁVALÓK:
1.5 pounds ground meatloaf mix
1 cup dried breadcrumbs
2 tbsp chopped flat-leaf parsley
2 large eggs
1 medium onion
1 clove garlic
0.5 cup ketchup
1 tbsp plus 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
kosher salt
black pepper
2 tsp light brown sugar

ELKÉSZÍTÉS:
1. Heat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet.
2. Combine the meat, breadcrumbs, parsley, eggs, onion, garlic, part of the ketchup, Worcestershire sauce and seasoning.
3. Shape the mixture into a compact loaf and bake for about 30 minutes.
4. Mix brown sugar with the remaining ketchup and Worcestershire sauce.
5. Brush the glaze over the loaf and continue baking until cooked through.
6. Rest before slicing.
21:
CÍM:
Easy chicken curry

HOZZÁVALÓK:
2 tbsp sunflower oil
1 onion
2 garlic cloves
thumb-sized piece of ginger
6 boneless skinless chicken thighs
3 tbsp medium spice paste
400g can chopped tomatoes
100g Greek yogurt
1 small bunch coriander
50g ground almonds
naan breads or basmati rice

ELKÉSZÍTÉS:
1. Fry the sliced onion in oil until golden.
2. Add garlic and ginger and cook briefly.
3. Add chunky chicken pieces and fry for several minutes.
4. Stir in spice paste, tomatoes and water, then simmer until reduced and the chicken is cooked.
5. Stir in yogurt, coriander and ground almonds.
6. Season and serve with naan or rice.
27:
CÍM:
Real tomato soup

HOZZÁVALÓK:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion
1 garlic clove
1 tbsp tomato purée
400g can chopped tomato
handful basil leaves
pinch bicarbonate of soda
600ml milk

ELKÉSZÍTÉS:
1. Soften the onion and garlic in olive oil.
2. Add tomato purée, chopped tomatoes and basil; simmer until thick.
3. Blend at this stage if a smooth soup is preferred.
4. Mix the bicarbonate of soda with a little milk.
5. Add the bicarbonate mixture and remaining milk to the tomato base.
6. Bring gently to the boil and simmer briefly before serving.
24:
CÍM:
Best ever chocolate brownies recipe

HOZZÁVALÓK:
185g unsalted butter
185g dark chocolate
85g plain flour
40g cocoa powder
50g white chocolate
50g milk chocolate
3 large eggs
275g golden caster sugar

ELKÉSZÍTÉS:
1. Melt the butter and dark chocolate together, then cool slightly.
2. Sift the flour and cocoa powder together.
3. Whisk the eggs and sugar until thick and pale.
4. Fold in the melted chocolate mixture, then the dry ingredients.
5. Fold in the chopped white and milk chocolate.
6. Bake in a lined tin until the top is set but the centre remains fudgy, then cool before cutting.
26:
CÍM:
Tomato soup

HOZZÁVALÓK:
1-1.25kg ripe tomatoes
1 medium onion
1 small carrot
1 celery stick
2 tbsp olive oil
2 tsp tomato purée
pinch of sugar
2 bay leaves
1.2 litres hot vegetable stock

ELKÉSZÍTÉS:
1. Roughly chop the tomatoes and prepare the onion, carrot and celery.
2. Soften the vegetables in olive oil.
3. Add tomato purée, sugar, bay leaves and the tomatoes.
4. Pour in the hot vegetable stock and simmer gently until the vegetables are very soft.
5. Remove the bay leaves and blend until smooth.
6. Adjust seasoning and serve.
